naming.metadata: Same basename as the primary image; keep one descriptor for shared color variants.
rules: No recoloring, resizing, pixel changes or changed animation order.
No automatic deduplication; bend/T/X remain distinct roles/files.
Renumber only within a family; change paths, never logical component IDs.

archive_policy.required_before_removal: Create and verify a portable ZIP and SHA-256 inventory of the full Zen bundle outside the project. Keep an independently retrievable copy; Git history alone is not the archive.
archive_policy.restore_note: Keep the archived profile and original relative paths. Shared dependencies remain in the game; save the complete rename map in the Zen bundle for restoration.

renderer_bypass_review.finding: Generative Tier 1 filters T01/T03; the junction layer filters ordinary center parts, including C01/C02/C03. Old parts are still validated from tier0/tier1 JSON.
renderer_bypass_review.action_later: Remove superseded set parts and their validation references before dropping any associated images.

renderer_bypass_review.finding: Generative Tier 1 filters arm_* and the junction layer filters ordinary junction-center parts. Their set definitions still validate images and masks.
renderer_bypass_review.action_later: Review old arm/junction compositions and masks against the replacement metadata before deleting their source files.

renderer_bypass_review.finding: Core roles can be composed from leaves, while explicit core artwork metadata remains in the theme configuration and validation graph.
renderer_bypass_review.action_later: Keep these references until the planned manifest/metadata cleanup resolves the distinction.

implementation_gates: Freeze/check this map against current hashes and make a Git checkpoint before migration.
Move/rewrite retained dependencies atomically; retain all validation-only artwork in this pass.
Create manifests from the mapped dependency closure; update registry, loaders, exporter, audit utilities and active tests.
Rewrite relative JSON paths semantically using their old and new owners; raw substring replacement is insufficient.
Rewrite dynamic finger/steam loaders using their mapped frame lists, retaining exact sequence and bounds.
Preserve import options and UIDs; regenerate remap/cache paths after relocation.
Update deprecated test-only references before removing unreferenced theme metadata; do not restore obsolete runtime artwork for old tests.
Verify and deliver the external Zen archive before removing its project copies or guarded loaders.
Then remove deletion candidates and generated renders, rebuild caches/staging, and verify a fresh APK against the manifests.
deferred: Do not delete validation-only legacy assets in this plan; removing their old set parts/code requires a separate dependency audit.
